parameters.name: Permissions
parameters.description: A collection of security group rule objects.

sub_parameters.name: Description
sub_parameters.description: The description of the security group rule. It must be 2 to 256 characters long and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: DestCidrIp
sub_parameters.description: The destination IPv4 CIDR block. This parameter supports CIDR notation and single IPv4 addresses.

sub_parameters.name: Direction
sub_parameters.description:
The traffic direction for the rule. Valid values:

- `egress`: Outgoing traffic.

- `ingress`: Incoming traffic.

sub_parameters.name: IpProtocol
sub_parameters.description:
The protocol type. Valid values:

- `TCP`

- `UDP`

- `ICMP`

- `ICMPv6`

- `ALL`: All protocols.

sub_parameters.name: Ipv6DestCidrIp
sub_parameters.description:
The destination IPv6 CIDR block. This parameter supports CIDR notation and single IPv6 addresses.

> This parameter and `DestCidrIp` are mutually exclusive.

sub_parameters.name: Ipv6SourceCidrIp
sub_parameters.description:
The source IPv6 CIDR block. This parameter supports CIDR notation and single IPv6 addresses.

> This parameter and `SourceCidrIp` are mutually exclusive.

sub_parameters.name: Policy
sub_parameters.description:
The access control policy. Valid values:

- `Accept`: Allows matching traffic.

- `Drop`: Denies matching traffic and drops the packets.

sub_parameters.name: PortRange
sub_parameters.description:
The destination port range for the rule.

- For TCP and UDP, the port range is 1 to 65535. Use a forward slash (/) to separate the start and end ports. For example, `1/200`.

- For ICMP, the value must be `-1/-1`.

- For ICMPv6, the value must be `-1/-1`.

- If you set `IpProtocol` to `ALL`, the value must be `-1/-1`.

sub_parameters.name: Priority
sub_parameters.description: The priority of the security group rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Valid values: 1 to 100.

sub_parameters.name: SourceCidrIp
sub_parameters.description: The source IPv4 CIDR block. This parameter supports CIDR notation and single IPv4 addresses.

sub_parameters.name: SourcePortRange
sub_parameters.description:
The source port range for the rule.

- For TCP and UDP, the port range is 1 to 65535. Use a forward slash (/) to separate the start and end ports. For example, `1/200`.

- For ICMP, the value must be `-1/-1`.

- For ICMPv6, the value must be `-1/-1`.

- If you set `IpProtocol` to `ALL`, the value must be `-1/-1`.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the security group.
